function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Hai! Sepertinya kamu sedang menanyakan ketersediaan produk berukuran **40** dan kapan akan tersedia lagi.  
Bisa kasih tahu dulu jenis barang apa yang kamu cari? Misalnya sepatu, kaus kaki, atau pakaian lainnya?  

Dengan informasi lebih detail saya bisa cek stoknya secara spesifik dan memberi perkiraan waktu pengiriman/ready‑up-nya. Terima kasih!

The user says: "Size 40 kapan ready kak". This seems like Indonesian? They might ask about product availability size 40 maybe shoes? "kapan ready kak" means when it will be ready (available). So they want info if there's an item with size 40 available soon.

We need to respond appropriately. We can interpret this as asking whether we have a product of size 40 ready. Since we don't know inventory, but we could do a product search for size 40. But our tool doesn't support searching by size; only keywords, category, price_range, sort_order, in_stock. Could use keyword "size 40"? Might not work. Maybe we should clarify what they're looking for. Ask them what type of product. Or provide general answer: check store website etc.

Better approach: ask clarifying question: What kind of product? Shoes? Clothing? Provide approximate timeframe. Also mention we can't guarantee exact time.

Thus reply politely asking clarification.
